holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the June 2026 quarter reached ₹16,276 crore compared to ₹14,456 crore in June 2025.
The bank received a GST show-cause notice on September 30, 2026, demanding ₹229.14 crore plus interest and penalty.
Anup Bagchi resigned as ICICI Life MD & CEO effective October 13, 2026, and Sidharatha Mishra was appointed from October 14, 2026.

expected.text: Nomura expects 17% core PPOP growth across preferred banks in Q2.

holdings.why_it_matters: ICICI Bank is the fund's largest position at 8.66% weight. Its 3-month return of -3.3% moderates portfolio performance, while the fund carries a combined 36.6% exposure to Financials.

watch.text: Monitor the outcome of the ₹229.14 crore GST show-cause notice proceedings.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: HDFC Bank reported net profit of ₹20,383 crore for the June 2026 quarter, up from ₹17,090 crore in June 2025.
The board appointed Anup Bagchi as MD & CEO for three years starting October 27, 2026.
As of September 2026, advances stood at ₹33,075 billion and deposits reached ₹33,275 billion.
Foreign institutional investors reduced their stake by 2.4% during the September 2026 quarter.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 7.78% weight, HDFC Bank's 3-month decline of -14.27% resulted in an estimated -1.11% drag on the fund, making it the top detractor in the portfolio.

watch.text: Watch the leadership transition under Anup Bagchi taking charge on October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: Revenue for the June 2026 quarter stood at ₹67,942 crore with a net profit of ₹4,988 crore.
The company secured an LNTP for a 2x800 MW thermal power plant in Jharkhand and mega EPC orders in Saudi Arabia, UAE, and India.
L&T extended the target timeline to dispose of its stake in L&T Metro Rail Hyderabad to December 31, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: L&T represents 5.43% of the portfolio within a 14.1% Industrials allocation. Its -6.15% 3-month return weighed on fund performance with a -0.538% estimated drag from the sector alongside Thermax.

watch.text: Track execution on international EPC wins and the completion of the Hyderabad Metro divestment by December 31, 2026.

holdings.name: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 sales rose to ₹35,244 crore from ₹30,212 crore in June 2025, with net profit rising to ₹1,076 crore.
The company allotted 10,32,09,960 equity shares following the conversion of 145,010 CCDs.
JCR upgraded the company's foreign currency long-term issuer rating outlook to Positive at an A rating.
The board approved acquiring a 50.1% stake in Rotary Connectors.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 3.77% fund weight, the stock delivered a 6.85% 3-month return, providing an estimated +0.258% positive contribution to the fund's Consumer Discretionary bucket.

watch.text: Monitor closing of the 50.1% acquisition in Rotary Connectors.

holdings.name: State Bank of India

what_changed.text: June 2026 quarter net profit increased to ₹25,121 crore from ₹22,121 crore in June 2025.
SBI bought approximately 40% of Reliance's $1.35 billion debt offering.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 3.67% weight, SBI's 3-month return of -7.42% added to the broader headwinds across the fund's 36.6% Financials exposure.

watch.text: Track the impact of central bank interest rate actions on bank margins and earnings.

holdings.name: Infosys Ltd

what_changed.text: Revenue reached ₹48,211 crore for the June 2026 quarter with an operating margin of 24%.
The US government suspended PERM green card processing for Infosys and several peers.
The company expanded AI collaborations with Columbia University and ABN AMRO.

holdings.why_it_matters: Infosys holds a 3.66% portfolio weight within a 9.9% Technology allocation. Its -4.18% 3-month return detracted from fund performance.

watch.text: Assess operational adjustments following US PERM visa program suspensions.

holdings.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Provisional Q2 FY27 advances were reported at ₹5,77,094 crore and deposits reached ₹6,51,491 crore.
The RBI approved Anup Kumar Saha as MD & CEO for three years starting January 1, 2027.
Subsidiaries KMIL and KAAML approved an amalgamation scheme.

expected.text: Nomura expects 17% core PPOP growth across preferred banks in Q2.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 3.65% weight, Kotak Mahindra Bank gained 16.79% over 3 months, generating an estimated +0.613% contribution and partially offsetting declines in other financial holdings.

watch.text: Observe upcoming Q2 FY27 earnings approval scheduled for October 24, 2026.
Track executive transition to incoming MD & CEO Anup Kumar Saha on January 1, 2027.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the June 2026 quarter was ₹23,196 crore on revenue of ₹309,468 crore.
The company allotted ₹13,008.6 crore of 7.90% unsecured NCDs maturing in October 2036.
CRISIL and CARE assigned AAA ratings with a Stable outlook to ₹67,000 crore of debentures.

expected.text: European diesel shortage is projected to lift Q2 O2C earnings by 38% to ₹20,700 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Reliance holds 3.59% of the fund as the anchor Energy & Utilities position. A 3-month return of -10.51% generated an estimated -0.377% portfolio drag.

watch.text: Monitor O2C earnings performance against European fuel export margins.

holdings.name: Asian Paints Ltd

what_changed.text: Operating profit rose to ₹2,169 crore in June 2026 from ₹1,625 crore in June 2025 on sales of ₹10,542 crore.
A postal ballot was initiated to appoint Leo Puri as Independent Director and incoming Chairman effective January 23, 2027.
The board scheduled a meeting for October 29, 2026, to consider Q2 results and an interim dividend with a record date of November 4, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Asian Paints represents 3.56% of the fund within a 12% Materials allocation. A -12.65% 3-month return generated an estimated -0.45% drag on fund returns.

watch.text: Follow board deliberations on interim dividends and quarterly earnings on October 29, 2026.
Monitor input cost pressures stemming from crude price movements.

holdings.name: Divi's Laboratories Ltd

what_changed.text: June 2026 operating profit expanded to ₹1,255 crore with operating margins improving to 41%.
Shareholders approved all AGM resolutions on August 10, 2026, including a ₹30 dividend per share.

expected.text: Citi maintains a Buy rating with a ₹11,700 price target based on oral Wegovy demand.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 3.49% weight, Divi's surged 36.63% over 3 months to deliver +1.278% in estimated contribution, making it the fund's top individual performer.

watch.text: Track peptide CDMO developments and supply traction linked to oral Wegovy.

portfolio.statement: SBI Large Cap Fund recorded a 3-month return of -6.03% and a 1-year return of -4.54%, pressured by heavy drawdowns in select private banks and materials.
interp: Top contributors Divi's Laboratories and Kotak Mahindra Bank partially offset sharp declines in HDFC Bank, Asian Paints, and Reliance Industries.
Heavy exposure to Financials at 36.6% made portfolio returns sensitive to banking sector corrections and foreign institutional selling.
portfolio.line: Performance diverged across large caps as healthcare and select financials gained while core banking and energy lagged.

drivers.text: Divi's Laboratories gained 36.63% over 3 months, providing an estimated 1.278% return contribution amid expanding margins.
HDFC Bank fell 14.27% over 3 months and pulled down fund return by an estimated -1.11% following FII stake sales.
Kotak Mahindra Bank rose 16.79% over 3 months, contributing an estimated 0.613% following CEO appointment clarity and loan growth.
